scenarios.name: headline-to-svg-path
scenarios.rationale: Both slice the ArrayBuffer exactly and use the default import, but B also derives the viewBox from path.getBoundingBox() as the rubric asks. A builds the viewBox from font metrics and only mentions getBoundingBox in a note.

scenarios.name: digit-font-subset
scenarios.rationale: A matches the rubric closely: it builds the font from .notdef plus glyphs deduplicated via charToGlyph, copies the metrics, writes with Buffer.from(toArrayBuffer()), says kerning, ligatures and hinting are dropped, and recommends pyftsubset or glyphhanger; B covers the loss points and pyftsubset well but copies glyphs into new Glyph objects without deduplicating and never mentions glyphhanger, so it fits the rubric less closely.

scenarios.name: measure-text-with-gsub-failure
scenarios.rationale: B explicitly wraps the call in try/catch, ties the error to GSUB lookups unimplemented in opentype.js 2.0.0, and gives the per-char charToGlyph advanceWidth sum with fontSize/unitsPerEm scaling and getKerningValue, while A skips the try/catch around the main call and explains the cause less precisely, though its fallback math is correct.
